subject: Follow-up: PLG signup credits and unexpected trial charges
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@freshcart.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Unexpected trial charge — invoice attached

Hi Jordan,

We signed up for Redwood via the PLG self-serve flow last week and received the $300 trial credits. Today I logged in and saw a charge on our card (small amount) and an invoice (attached) that shows token usage and VAT. We never upgraded or submitted a payment intent manually — I think tokens were billed during a large batch test. Can you explain how the trial credits are supposed to apply and whether that invoice is legitimate?

Two asks: 1) can the charge be reversed if it was covered by the trial credit, and 2) can we get a 30-day extension on the trial credits while we finalize our evaluation?

Attached: invoice_000123.pdf (shows invoice lines + tax)

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Barnes
Head of ML Ops, FreshCart
olivia@freshcart.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@freshcart.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected trial charge — invoice attached

Hi Olivia — thanks for raising this and sorry for the confusion. Short answer: PLG trial credits should offset eligible usage; you should not be billed while credits remain. There are a couple of ways a small charge can show up: VAT/tax applied by the payment processor for your billing address, or usage that exceeded the credit balance before the credit was applied.

I'm looping in Vivek from billing to check the invoice and Marissa from solutions so we can confirm what happened. Could you send the FreshCart account/org ID (or the email you used to sign up) and the last 4 digits of the card charged? That will speed things up.

Next steps (what I'll do):
- Vivek will confirm whether the invoice is a system-generated tax-only invoice vs. a usage charge.
- If this should have been covered by trial credits, we'll issue a reversal/provisional credit and follow up with finance for a full refund if appropriate.
- I can approve a 30-day trial extension for FreshCart while we sort the billing.

I'll aim to have an update within the day.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.com]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia@freshcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 14:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unexpected trial charge — investigating invoice 000123

Hi Olivia / Jordan,

Thanks — I pulled the billing logs for FreshCart (acct id: FC-00421 from the sign-up email) and see the following:
- Trial promo credit of $300 applied on 2026-02-13.
- A usage event on 2026-02-19 that consumed tokens; system applied the promotional credit but a tax line (VAT) of $12.40 was recorded by the payments vendor for your billing address (GB VAT rules).
- The invoice generated is a tax invoice (system treats VAT as payable even when credits cover net usage). The net usage amount after promo credit was zero.

What we can do:
1) Issue a provisional credit for the VAT amount while we request a VAT reversal with the payments processor. Timeline for processor reversal is typically 5–10 business days.
2) Mark this account with a 30-day trial extension and ensure no further accidental charges.
3) Share a short breakdown showing how the promo credit was applied vs the tax to help FreshCart reconcile.

I've attached a provisional credit memo (provisional_credit_memo_654.pdf) and a snapshot of the account usage. Please confirm the card last 4 digits so we can submit the reversal request.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Billing Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
[vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com]

[Attachment: provisional_credit_memo_654.pdf]
[Attachment: account_snapshot.png]

Thanks Vivek — really appreciate the quick response. Card last 4 digits are 4242. Account ID is FC-00421 (you nailed it).

Confirming: please issue the provisional credit for the VAT and start the reversal. Also please go ahead with the 30-day extension — we were mid-eval and would like to run a final integration test.

One question on timing: if the payments processor takes up to 10 business days, can you show FreshCart the provisional credit on our billing dashboard so this appears reconciled on our side?

Thanks again — Jordan, Marissa — cc'ing our finance contact if helpful: Tom Li <tom.li@freshcart.com>.

Best,
Olivia

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Unexpected trial charge — confirming credits & extension

Hi Olivia / Tom — quick update to confirm everything is in motion: 

- I approved a 30-day trial extension for FC-00421 starting today (new expiry: 2026-03-24).
- Vivek created a provisional credit for $12.40 to offset the VAT and submitted a reversal request with the payments processor (ref BILL-452). That provisional credit will show in your Redwood billing dashboard immediately; the processor refund, if approved, posts back to your card in 5–10 business days.
- Marissa will follow up offline to help tune batch settings so you don't hit unexpectedly large usage spikes during tests.

Olivia — I'll keep this thread updated and flag once finance confirms the reversal. If you need a written credit confirmation for internal accounting, the attached provisional_credit_memo_654.pdf should suffice for now.

Cheers,
